description: This file defines a global exception handler for a Spring Boot application, providing centralized handling for various exceptions and returning structured HTTP responses.

classes.name: GlobalExceptionHandler
classes.description: A centralized exception handling component annotated with @ControllerAdvice, providing methods to handle specific exceptions and generate consistent error responses.

methods.name: handleNotFound
methods.description: Handles NotFoundException by returning a 404 Not Found response with error details.

methods.name: handleValidation
methods.description: Handles validation exceptions (MethodArgumentNotValidException) by returning a 400 Bad Request with validation error details.

methods.name: handleGeneric
methods.description: Handles all other exceptions by returning a 500 Internal Server Error with the exception message.
